passages.provision_quote: A. it is unlawful for a person who is an alien to enter or attempt to enter this state directly from a foreign nation at any location other than a lawful port of entry.
passages.note: A state crime for crossing outside a port of entry, with a federal asylum grant as an affirmative defense, is enforcement only (rung 3 clause [a] at most) and says nothing about who may claim asylum; the annex also gives a state office no lever on this ladder.
Bill overview lists Shamp as prime sponsor of the illegal-border-crossing bill, vetoed 03/04/2024.

passages.provision_quote: A. It is unlawful for a person who is an alien to enter or attempt to enter this state directly from a foreign nation at any location other than a lawful port of entry.
passages.note: The referred measure bundles public-benefit fraud, fentanyl sentencing, e-verify and state illegal entry, so a Yes proves direction at most, and the entry clause is enforcement only with an asylum affirmative defense.
Senate third-reading vote: Shamp Yes on a divided 16-13 tally of a multi-subject measure.
Her statement condemning the veto names no asylum clause; the reporter's account of the bill is context only.
Quoted statement about an "invasion" names no policy clause; the reporter's description of SB 1231 is not a record (H15).

rows.reasoning: The annex gives only federal offices a lever on asylum and border handling, and Shamp is a state senator. Her own record, prime sponsorship and a Yes on SB 1231 (2024) making it a state crime to enter "at any location other than a lawful port of entry", is enforcement only with a federal asylum grant as a defense, so even on its content it reaches no rung's asylum clause (e.g. "Sharply restrict who can claim asylum at the border" or "End asylum"); her quoted statements are rhetorical.

quotes.text: The Legislature did its job to protect our citizens, but Governor Hobbs failed to do hers. Vetoing the Arizona Border Invasion Act is a prime example of the chaos Hobbs is unleashing in our state while perpetuating this open border crisis as Biden's accomplice
